C. Garden Fence
time limit per test
1 second
memory limit per test
64 megabytes

Farmer Olga owns n fence posts. The height of post i is hi. The picture below shows an example.

She calls the fence tidy if no two neighbouring posts differ by more than k.

Input

The first line contains two integers n and k (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000, 0 ≤ k ≤ 109). The second line contains n integers h1, h2, ..., hn.

Output

Print YES if the fence is tidy, and NO otherwise.

Examples
Input
3 1
1 2 3
Output
YES
